footer.tagline: A batteries-included Nuxt + Supabase starter for shipping SaaS fast.
landing.seoDescription: A multi-tenant Nuxt + Supabase starter with auth, billing-ready architecture, notifications, i18n and observability.
landing.heroTitle: Ship your SaaS, not your boilerplate
landing.heroSubtitle: Auth, multi-tenancy, notifications, observability and testing, wired up and ready. Start building your product on day one.
landing.featuresSubtitle: The undifferentiated heavy lifting, already done, so you can focus on what makes your product yours.
landing.features.auth.title: Auth & roles
landing.features.auth.body: Email/password and social login, password reset, and role-aware route guards.
landing.features.tenancy.title: Multi-tenancy
landing.features.tenancy.body: Every table scoped to a tenant with Postgres Row Level Security, safe by construction.
landing.features.notifications.title: Notifications
landing.features.notifications.body: In-app feed plus transactional email, driven by database triggers.
landing.features.observability.title: Observability
landing.features.observability.body: Error tracking, log forwarding and web-vitals analytics out of the box.
landing.features.i18n.title: Internationalization
landing.features.i18n.body: Bilingual by default with enforced translation-key parity in CI.
landing.features.testing.title: Tested
landing.features.testing.body: Unit, end-to-end and accessibility tests wired into the pipeline.
landing.finalCtaBody: Clone the template, run one command, and start shipping.
